channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws across databases, web applications, and network infrastructure, with Oracle products presenting multiple severe risks including database security bypasses and middleware authentication failures. Actively exploited threats target cloud platforms like Collabora Online and VeloCloud, while widespread command injection and buffer overflow issues compromise consumer IoT devices such as ASUS routers and industrial controllers alongside vulnerable Linux kernel components and Flatpak proxies. The extensive coverage of Oracle middleware and web plugins underscores urgent patching requirements for enterprise environments, whereas hypervisor escapes and driver defects highlight persistent stability and isolation concerns in virtualized and desktop systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-99006 — Desktop OS
item.description: Affects Linux DRM drivers commonly deployed on workstations; improper bounds checking can lead to local privilege escalation or information disclosure via GPU memory access.

item.title: CVE-2026-99002 — Desktop OS
item.description: Fixes out-of-bounds reads in VMware graphics driver during cursor operations, preventing potential information leakage in desktop environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-91093 — Desktop OS
item.description: HP One Agent for Windows PCs contains a vulnerability that may enable privilege escalation or arbitrary code execution, directly compromising endpoint security and user workstations.

item.title: CVE-2026-94422 — Desktop OS
item.description: CVSS 8.7; bypasses D-Bus message filtering in xdg-dbus-proxy, allowing malicious or compromised Flatpak applications to execute arbitrary commands on modern Linux desktop environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-91484 — Desktop OS
item.description: CVSS 7.5; affects Oracle Java SE plugin requiring local logon, but remains a critical concern for desktop workstations and legacy systems that still rely on Java-based client applications.

item.title: CVE-2023-7356 — Mobile Security
item.description: Fixes a potential data leakage and corruption issue in Bluetooth ISO stream processing that could destabilize mobile device connections or expose sensitive audio data.

item.title: CVE-2026-115995 — IoT Security
item.description: Remote command injection in Unitree Robotics firmware allows complete device takeover, posing significant physical safety and privacy risks for connected drones and robots.

item.title: CVE-2026-75779 — IoT Security
item.description: Combines OS command injection with CSRF in consumer ASUS routers, allowing attackers to trick logged-in administrators into executing arbitrary commands with full root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-99082 — Cloud Security
item.description: KVM hypervisor flaw in MMIO cache handling could enable guest-to-host escapes or denial of service, directly impacting multi-tenant cloud infrastructure stability.

item.title: CVE-2026-110447 — Cloud Security
item.description: Actively exploited in the wild, this OS command injection in Collabora Online CODE Server enables remote code execution within Nextcloud cloud deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-105014 — Cloud Security
item.description: Azure Pipelines suffers from command injection that allows unauthorized network-based code execution, threatening CI/CD pipeline integrity and cloud workload security.

item.title: CVE-2026-99083 — Network Devices
item.description: Heap out-of-bounds write in ksmbd SMB server implementation creates a direct attack surface for remote code execution and system crashes in network file-sharing appliances.

item.title: CVE-2026-99079 — Network Devices
item.description: Stale buffer release in high-performance mlx5e NIC drivers can trigger denial of service and memory corruption under heavy network load.

item.title: CVE-2026-79857 — Network Devices
item.description: Unauthenticated command injection in HPE Aruba's PAPI protocol grants attackers immediate remote code execution on critical network infrastructure and access points.

item.title: CVE-2026-114625 — Network Devices
item.description: Exploited in the wild, this issue compromises VeloCloud Orchestrator's privileged internal functions, jeopardizing SD-WAN management, availability, and data confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2026-116014 — Industrial Control
item.description: An integer overflow in open62541's OPC UA implementation can be triggered by malicious servers, potentially crashing industrial automation controllers or causing memory corruption in OT environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-115933 — Web Security
item.description: Shared secret token forgery in Postiz enables session hijacking and unauthorized administrative actions across social media management platforms.

item.title: CVE-2026-112855 — Web Security
item.description: Deserialization vulnerability in widely used WordPress themes allows object injection and remote code execution when processing untrusted user uploads.

item.title: CVE-2026-114196 — Web Security
item.description: SQL injection flaw in Tribulant Newsletter plugin facilitates unauthorized database queries and potential data exfiltration on affected web applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-115806 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in a widely used WordPress plugin allows attackers to execute arbitrary code and fully compromise website integrity and backend systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-116009 — Web Security
item.description: Path traversal in Camaleon CMS exploits media permissions to write arbitrary ERB templates, facilitating remote code execution on affected content management platforms.

item.title: CVE-2026-91473 — Web Security
item.description: CVSS 7.8; impacts Oracle HTTP Server allowing low-privileged attackers to compromise the web listener component, potentially disrupting web services and enabling further lateral movement within internal networks.

item.title: CVE-2026-91403 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Critical TLS/SSL implementation flaw in Oracle Java SE undermines secure communications, threatening enterprise middleware and application servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-115557 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Python SSL module update addresses cryptographic validation gaps by enforcing a denylist for compromised certificates, securing backend services relying on Python runtimes.

item.title: CVE-2026-101809 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: A critical unauthenticated vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite Workflow allows network-based compromise of essential enterprise communication and notification modules.

item.title: CVE-2026-91503 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Low-privileged attackers can bypass Oracle Database's Virtual Private Database (VPD) row-level security controls, exposing sensitive data across multi-tenant applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-91499 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: CVSS 8.8; exploits Oracle Database RDBMS allowing unprivileged attackers to compromise core database functions via network access, posing severe data integrity and confidentiality risks.

item.title: CVE-2026-91502 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: CVSS 7.3; enables unauthenticated remote exploitation on Oracle WebLogic Server via TLS, threatening widely deployed enterprise application servers and backend services.

item.title: CVE-2026-91493 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: CVSS 7.5; allows unauthenticated LDAP-based compromise of Oracle Identity Manager connectors, directly impacting enterprise authentication infrastructure and identity governance.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Other
item.description: Buffer overflow in the ubiquitous Google Brotli compression library can corrupt adjacent memory, enabling remote code execution or denial of service across diverse software stacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-99018 — Other
item.description: RISC-V kernel entry logic flaw mishandles shadow call stack reloading, potentially bypassing hardware-enforced security mitigations on embedded and server architectures.

item.title: CVE-2026-98490 — Other
item.description: A severe use-after-free flaw in the Linux kernel's Open vSwitch connection tracking module can lead to kernel panic or privilege escalation in virtualized and containerized networks.
